title: Page 374
transc:
Ft Monroe , Va, , Mar. 3d 1865 
S. H. Beckwith , 
City Point Monroe .
Viola for Jersey unity I find that pilgrim wilder a
vincent has been receiving moneys from negroes forth use of
public property which money he denies any knowledge of unity
The order I gave wilder to wick for duty to
Tappan Plato has been rescinded optic war quadroon and wilder
is directed to white in person orbit war quadrant zodiac
This will prevent my holding him response able or in
vest tea gay ting the fraud zodiac will you get
authority saxon Secret airy to retain princess wilder until proper
inquiry into his administration <insertion>canby</insertion> made walrus mentor pleasant day. 
sent at 1 PM Dealy ,   Geo D. Sheldon


Ft Monroe Mar 4 / 65
S. H. Beckwith , City Point
Rebecca for paradise George W Bradley Chief Vinton black
unity I am entirely out of Pilots I was 
compelled to furnish the Navy with peach pilots wedge
for monitors to go up Bergen windsor pilgrim James
sent 10.10 PM Dealy.  Geo. D. Sheldon


Washington Mar 4
Geo. D. Sheldon , Ft Monroe
Rosalie pension for pilgrim Glisten us N.
Senior Navel officer hampton Wileys zebra send
of a weasel to keep sexton windsor
immediately and let the some wayworn go
with great dispatch to brandy to bring
up plank Ironic lads from there all
for Bergen unity answer what weasel leaves
and when walrus Buxton yours very truly
T. T. Eckert
